introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.body: Astra Browser is built around privacy and local control. This Privacy Policy explains what data stays on your device, what optional services you may choose to use, and what the Astra project does not collect.
introduction.summary: No Astra telemetry — No Astra cloud sync — Your browsing data stays on your device

noCollect.title: 1. What Astra Does Not Collect
noCollect.body: The Astra project does not operate a telemetry pipeline, analytics service, or cloud sync backend. We do not receive your browsing history, search queries, bookmarks, passwords, or other personal data from your use of Astra Browser.

noTelemetry.title: 1.1. No Astra Telemetry
noTelemetry.body: Astra removes Mozilla Firefox telemetry and crash reporting that would send data to Mozilla by default. The Astra team does not collect usage statistics, crash dumps, or diagnostic reports from your browser.
noTelemetry.body2: If you choose to send feedback through GitHub, email, or Discord, you control what you share in those messages.

noPersonalData.title: 1.2. No Personal Data Collection by Astra
noPersonalData.body: Astra does not collect personal information such as your IP address, browsing history, search queries, or form data. Anything you browse or type stays on your device unless you explicitly use a third-party feature described below.

noThirdParty.title: 1.3. No Third-Party Tracking by Astra
noThirdParty.body: Astra does not embed third-party analytics or advertising trackers. Tracking protection features help limit cross-site tracking by websites you visit, but individual sites may still set cookies or request data according to their own policies.

externalConnections.title: 1.4. Connections the Browser May Make
externalConnections.body: Like other browsers, Astra may connect to the internet to check for updates, verify add-on updates, load web pages you request, and support standard web features (for example, push notifications or geolocation when a site asks and you allow it). These connections serve the page or feature you requested — they are not an Astra telemetry pipeline. Advanced users can review and adjust many network-related settings in about:config.

localStorage.title: 2. Information Stored Locally on Your Device

browsingData.title: 2.1. Browsing Data
browsingData.body: Astra stores certain data locally on your device to enhance your browsing experience. This includes:

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Cookies are stored locally on your device and are not shared with Astra or any third party. You have full control over the management of cookies through the browser's settings.

cache.title: Cache and Temporary Files
cache.body: Astra may store cache files and other temporary data locally to improve performance. These files can be cleared at any time through the browser's settings.

settings.title: 2.2. Settings and Preferences
settings.body: Any customizations, settings, and preferences you make within Astra are stored locally on your device. We do not have access to or control over this data.

sync.title: 3. Optional Firefox Sync
sync.body: Astra does not provide its own cloud sync service. If you choose to enable Mozilla Firefox Sync, your encrypted data is handled by Mozilla’s infrastructure under their privacy policy — not by Astra. Astra cannot read synced data. Local Auto-Backup stores copies on your device only and does not upload them to Astra.

addons.title: 4. Add-ons and Mods
addons.body:
You can install add-ons from addons.mozilla.org; Astra checks for add-on updates through Mozilla’s systems when you use that feature.
You can also install Mods from astra-browser.app/mods. Mod files are static content downloaded to your device. This website does not use analytics or tracking scripts when you download mods.

security.title: 5. Data on Your Device
security.body: Bookmarks, history, settings, and backups created by Astra are stored locally on your device. We recommend using device encryption, strong passwords, and keeping your software up to date.
security.note: Core security mechanisms inherit from the Firefox/Gecko codebase; see Mozilla’s documentation for engine-level details.

control.title: 6. Your Control
control.deletionBody: You have full control over all data stored locally on your device by Astra. You can clear your browsing data, cookies, and cache at any time using the browser's settings.

website.title: 7. This Website
website.body: The astra-browser.app website is a static site. We do not run third-party analytics, advertising trackers, or Astra-owned telemetry on this site. Basic hosting infrastructure (for example, Cloudflare) may process HTTP requests for security and delivery; that processing is not linked to your Astra Browser usage.
website.externalLinksBody: This site and Astra may link to external services such as GitHub or Discord. Those services have their own privacy policies. Review them before sharing personal information there.

changes.title: 8. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy when practices or legal requirements change. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised. Continued use of Astra after updates means you accept the revised policy.
